scene: Atop the roof wall, three transit stations wait under neon signs.
picture: Side-view pixel art of a raised catwalk. Far left, an open pneumatic capsule sits in a brass tube dock. Left of centre, the Pacific Islander teenage girl in windbreaker and shorts stands holding her sketchbook. Centre, a tethered, shimmering bubble lift bobs gently. Far right, a paint-splattered yellow tram rests on sky rails.
shown: a sleek pneumatic glass capsule waiting open far left
a shimmering giant soap bubble tethered to a dock centre
a brightly paint-splattered aerial tram car doors open far right
